test_title: SSC CHSL 2025 Tier-1 (Held On: 20 Nov, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Choose the correct meaning of the idiom: **On the same wavelength**

options.text: Talking to someone for a long time
Having similar ideas and understanding each other well
Waiting for a good opportunity to speak
Arguing about a different point of view

solution:
The correct answer is '2' i.e. Having similar ideas and understanding each other well .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"On the same wavelength"** means that two people share similar ideas, opinions, or ways of thinking and can understand each other well.
 
• This phrase is often used in the context of teamwork, relationships, or conversations where mutual understanding is evident.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Example of Usage:** 
 
 
• John and Sarah work well together because they are always on the same wavelength.
 
 
 
• **Similar Idioms:** 
 
 
• **See eye to eye:** To agree completely with someone.
 
• **Be on the same page:** To share the same understanding or agreement about something.
